abstractEnglish: We construct an infinite group with an ordinary finite presentation in which every element has finite order, answering the finitely presented Burnside question negatively. We also construct an infinite-dimensional finitely presented nonunital nil associative algebra over 𝔽2 that is Jacobson radical but not nilpotent. Its unitization is finitely presented, algebraic, and infinite-dimensional. These algebras answer the finitely presented nil- and radical-algebra nilpotence questions and the finite-presentation version of Kurosh's algebraic finiteness question negatively.

details.overview: 稿件研究有限呈现Burnside问题及相关代数结构。作者声称构造一个具有普通有限呈现且每个元素阶有限的无限群，从而否定有限呈现Burnside问题；还构造𝔽2上无限维有限呈现非单位零结合代数，为Jacobson根但非幂零，其单位化有限呈现、代数且无限维。摘要称这些代数否定有限呈现零代数与根代数幂零问题及Kurosh代数有限性问题的有限呈现版本。手稿为AI产生，未经独立审查或同行评议。
keyPoints: 构造无限、有限呈现且每元素有限阶的群，否定有限呈现Burnside问题
构造𝔽2上无限维有限呈现非单位零结合代数，Jacobson根但非幂零
